items.evidence_summary: Current official careers page is actively accepting candidacies and explicitly lists Diseño web y WordPress with WordPress, Elementor and UX/UI. The official application form includes Colaboración freelance as an selectable area/relationship option and requires a CV PDF upload.
items.why_high_value: Direct current agency demand with explicit WordPress/Elementor/UX fit and an explicit freelance-collaboration option in Spain.
verified_facts: The official careers page states candidatures are open.
Diseño web / WordPress is a selectable work area.
WordPress, Elementor and UX/UI are explicitly listed.
Colaboración freelance is explicitly selectable in the official application form.
The official route requires a CV PDF upload.
inferences: Exact freelance commercial terms, rates and workload are not stated and must not be inferred.
safe_alternative_angles: Manual application through the official careers form emphasizing WordPress/frontend, Elementor, UX/UI, performance, maintenance and pragmatic VDS Engine benefits.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not substitute a generic company contact for the official application route.
Do not claim submission unless the form action is actually completed.
Do not upload a CV unless the exact attachment is owner-approved.
recommended_human_checks: Confirm the form remains operational immediately before submission.
Select truthful freelance + Diseño web/WordPress options.
Use only an owner-approved CV PDF and truthful portfolio evidence.
